patternStatus: No APG pattern describes full screen. The trigger answers the Button pattern, read on 2026-09-24, and the region answers the WHATWG Fullscreen API Living Standard of 17 July 2026; both are transcribed item by item in docs/history/designs/2026-09-24-fullscreen-design.md section 2

modes.native: the Fullscreen API: the root is the document's fullscreen element, the agent draws nothing else, and the agent owns Escape
modes.layout: the root is fixed over the viewport inside the page; the page's scroll is locked and Escape asks to leave through dismissable-layer
modes.auto: asks for native inside the gesture and enters layout when the API is absent or refuses; the state stays true and the error is emitted
modes.reason: Plyr ships fallback true, false and force; ahooks ships pageFullscreen. A native-only mode is two lines of consumer code, onFullscreenError setting the state to false, so the family ships the two modes that cannot be composed

escape.native: never listened to. The specification's close request leaves full screen before any close watcher, and a family that listened could only fight it
escape.layout: a dismissable layer that takes Escape and no outside press, so a layer opened inside the region closes first

wiring.type: button on the trigger, unless the consumer wrote another
wiring.aria-pressed: never. The Button pattern: a toggle whose label changes with its state is not announced as pressed
wiring.aria-label: the current message on an iconOnly trigger, unless the consumer wrote one; a visible label otherwise
wiring.disabled: the platform's own attribute on the trigger, with data-disabled beside it

keyboard.effect: toggles full screen from the trigger
toggles full screen from the trigger
in layout, asks to leave with the reason escape once every layer opened inside has closed; in native, the agent leaves and the family reports it with the same reason
keyboard.focus: stays where it was, or returns to the element that held it on entry when it was left on the body

keyboard.effect: wraps inside the root while it is full screen; the rest of the page is not painted
keyboard.focus: the next tabbable element of the root
the previous tabbable element of the root

icon.alignment: to the label's text, not to the line box

errors.unsupported: the API is absent: a phone's browser, an iframe without allow=fullscreen
errors.refused: the agent rejected the request: no transient activation, a permission policy

shortcut.reason: Plyr answers F. A one-letter shortcut belongs to the product, which knows whether a field or a search is under the reader's hands: onKeyDown={(event) => event.key === 'f' && handle.toggle()}

iosNative.reason: webkitEnterFullscreen exists on a video element on an iPhone only; the consumer's video calls it, and the region answers the iPhone with layout

nativeOnly.reason: onFullscreenError={() => setFullscreen(false)} composes it; a mode for it would be a third way through the same request

inert.reason: layout is not modal. The live announcer lives on the body, and an inert body silences the announcement of how to leave; Tab is contained instead. Cost: a screen reader's virtual cursor reaches the covered page

dataAttributes.data-mode: native or layout on the root while it is full screen; absent otherwise

identity.root: data-ui=fullscreen and data-part=root on the region
identity.trigger: data-ui=fullscreen and data-part=trigger on the control, because the control may stand outside the region — a toolbar above a chart, the page header above a document — and a descendant selector from the root would not reach it
identity.reason: one family, one identifier; the part says which of the two elements it is
